cohort: Participants included 1,677 non-smoking women from three cohorts (CANDLE, TIDES, and GAPPS) in the ECHO PATHWAYS Consortium.
finding: Higher prenatal 2-OH-NAP exposure was associated with earlier gestational age at birth, with some associations varying by infant sex, suggesting females may be more susceptible to spontaneous PTB or shorter GA following exposure to certain OH-PAHs.
